name: Human Behaviour, Technology and Design
description: Human life and technology are intertwined. It is difficult for an average person to imagine going through one day without using any technology. However, human beings are efficient but imperfect information processors and decision makers. Because of this, human behavior and decision are often marked by systematic departure from logical, rational ‘norms’. This course examines how technology and design interacts with, and changes, human behavior, and how human behavior redefines the status quo of technology and design
